newsitem.title: USA: ITT shares may have seen best days - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: ITT shares may have seen best days - WSJ.

text.p: ITT Corp's stock may be overvalued, trading at a rich 10 times cash flow estimates for 1997 made by Salomon Brothers, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday, citing analysts.
The paper said in the "Heard on the Street" column of its electronic edition that questions are being raised about the ultimate values of the company, given weak results in its gaming business.
The paper also said that ITT Destinations could be shielded from any future takeover attempts because of a potential tax liability, according to tax experts.
What's more, some big shareholders have been selling ITT's stock, the paper added, citing a "knowledgeable" person on Wall Street.
Among the sellers were ITT's fifth-biggest shareholder, Capital Research & Management, according to the paper.
One analyst, Bruce Turner of Salomon Brothers, said the stock could be worth as low as $50-$55 a share on the downside.
